notes: Paper presents new 95% C.L. upper limits on dark photon kinetic mixing epsilon using in-situ Parker Solar Probe (PSP) FIELDS/RFS radio data (Oct 2018 - Jul 2022), via resonant DPDM-to-photon conversion in the solar wind plasma. Mass range 3e-10 to 8e-8 eV (70 kHz - 20 MHz), with epsilon limits ~1e-14 to 1e-13, surpassing CMB bounds. Exact curve is in Fig. 2 (not tabulated); the emitted data_points are approximate reconstructions anchored to the paper's stated endpoints (epsilon ~1e-13 at both mass edges) and the quoted best reach of ~1e-14; intermediate shape is interpolated from the plot description, so numerical values are approximate. Limits are quoted as epsilon*(rho_A'/rho_DM)^0.5, i.e. assuming DPDM constitutes the full local DM density; the paper does not explicitly state the numeric rho_DM value, 0.3 GeV/cm^3 assumed as standard. Weaker STEREO limits and an axion-photon reinterpretation (g_agamma ~1e-9 GeV^-1, not competitive) are also discussed but the primary result is the PSP dark photon limit. | selector: text (sole candidate) | axis-peek for confusable-family text read (#625 Phase 3c)
